text:
Ava (Growth): Quick ask — we need a "quickstrike" launch pack for next Thu. Minimal: hero stat card, 1-slide routing + 2 social tiles. Final Wed COB.
Ben (Design): Understood. Preferred formats? sizes?
Ava (Growth): Web hero 1200x630 PNG + SVG, slide 16:9 Figma template, socials 1200x1200 & 1080x1920. Also add an accessible colorway.
Claire (Creative Ops): Metrics to call out: p50 latency @typical seq, tokens/sec at batching, cost/1k tokens (hosted vs dedicated), and caching improvement. Only pull numbers from the internal eval doc — no estimates.
FigmaBot: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/quickstrike-launch-kit — comment access enabled.
Ben (Design): Cool. I'll scaffold components and include a muted footnote area for sources. Any routing metadata for HubSpot?
Ava (Growth): Yes — paste into Figma notes as hidden fields:
```
utm_source=quickstrike
webinar_slug=inference-launch-apr
hidden_field=campaign_source
```
Devon (Legal): Reminder: quantitative claims need a small-type source line with the eval link and test date. Avoid absolute statements or competitor calls. I'll review claims after upload.
Claire (Creative Ops): Checklist for handoff:
- Hero stat card (SVG + PNG 2x)
- Figma slide template (componentized)
- Social tiles x2 copy variants + alt text in notes
- Accessibility colorway + contrast report
- Legal source footnote on all assets
Ben (Design): Timeline: comps Mon EOD, internal review Tue, legal Wed AM, final Wed COB. Ship static first; animation is optional.
Ava (Growth): Thanks — I'll post the eval rows to cite in the thread shortly. Keep copy engineer-forward and short.
Ben (Design): Starting now, will ping when mocks are live. :rocket:
